title: John Calvin
source: Public domain. Consolidated from John Calvin, Commentary on the Gospel according to John, translated by William Pringle, Calvin Translation Society, and the Institutes of the Christian Religion, translated by Henry Beveridge; both as published by the Christian Classics Ethereal Library.
body: John Calvin on John, chapter 5. In his Commentary on the Gospel according to John, in the William Pringle translation, Calvin writes at John 5, verse 1: There was a feast of the Jews. Though the Evangelist does not expressly state what feast this was, yet the probable conjecture is that he means Pentecost, at least if what is here related took place immediately after that Christ came into Galilee. In the Institutes of the Christian Religion, in the Henry Beveridge translation, Calvin draws on this chapter again in Book 1, chapter 13.
